frase_gancho.texto: An avenue designed to trick the eyes and command every step.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The six-hundred-meter stretch between the San Juan River and the Pyramid of the Sun is a masterpiece of urban stagecraft. As you climb its staircases and cross its transverse plazas, you will notice how the walls block the horizon and make the sound of your footsteps bounce back. On either side of this route you will discover buildings buried one inside another like Russian nesting dolls and elite residences where a mysterious floor of mica brought from Oaxaca was found.
